verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes CoreWeave's Kubernetes/node-pool architecture, spot/on-demand capacity, and API tooling, but never lists specific GPU SKUs or generations (no mention of H100, H200, B200, A100, L40, etc.) nor any explicit claim that customers can pick between current- and previous-generation GPU classes. Without concrete evidence of the actual GPU catalog/generation choice, this capability cannot be confirmed from the pack.
